title: Renaming nested columns containing invalid characters with pyspark
question:
I'm having some issues renaming columns that contain invalid characters in databricks using pyspark, invalid chacacters such as .#()%$ etc.

I have a table that has a column with values that looks like this:

{
  "content_info": [
    {
      "#_of_cool_stuff": {
        "value": ""
      },
      "%_cool_stuff": {
        "value": ""
      },
      "my_money_($)": {
        "value": ""
      },
      "money_for_stuff_(%)": null,
      "some_key._text": {
        "value": ""
      }
    },
    ...
   ],
  "some_key": "..."
}

Below is a sample of the code I'm running for changing the column name of one with invalid characters. I've tested this on a column that doesn't contain special characters and was able to rename the column like I wanted.

df = df.withColumn(
    "my_column",
    F.when(
        F.col("my_column.content_info").isNotNull(),
        F.col("my_column").withField(
            "content_info",
            F.transform(
                F.col("my_column.content_info"),
                lambda x: x.withField(
                    "num_of_cool_sutff",
                    x["`#_of_cool_stuff`"]
                ).dropFields("`#_of_cool_stuff`")
            )
        )
    ).otherwise(F.lit(None))
)

I'm not able to select the column with backticks. Am I using the backticks incorrectly or is there another way I could be doing this?
answer:
Looks like you resolved your issue but I want to share an alternative approach which you can rename multiple struct field names at once.

First, create a schema that matches your array's schema with the names you want to transform to.

child_schema = StructType([StructField("value", StringType())])

schema = ArrayType(StructType([
    StructField("num_of_cool_stuff", child_schema),
    StructField("perc_cool_stuff", child_schema),
    StructField("money_for_stuff_perc", StringType()),
    StructField("my_money_dollar", child_schema),
    StructField("some_key_text", child_schema),
]))

Then, use cast to apply this schema

df = (df.withColumn(
       'my_column', 
       F.when(
         F.col("my_column.content_info").isNotNull(),
         F.col("my_column").withField(
           "content_info", 
           F.col("my_column.content_info").cast(schema))
       ).otherwise(F.lit(None))))
